name: manifest-dev-tools
description: Tools for prompts and PRs alongside the manifest workflow. Includes collaborative PR walkthroughs, autonomous PR review that re-verifies a manifest gate by gate, author-side PR babysitting that drives the lifecycle toward green and mergeable, hill-climbing an existing artifact toward a goal through figure-out, define and do, gap-calibrated prompt engineering, standalone goals written from a Manifest, a figure-out read or any other source, cross-boundary context handoff, incremental teaching, and an eli5 explainer that renders any topic as big pictures and few words.
